name: harness-evo
description: Watches a coding agent while it works: nudges good habits, gates unverified stops, blocks destructive actions, grades PRs on code and trace, and measures harness changes against a baseline.

strictness.title: Strictness
strictness.description: observe: log only, never block. standard: gate unverified stops and deny destructive actions; other detectors log only until proven. strict: every detector at its full level.

prompt_mode.title: Prompt storage
prompt_mode.description: text: store prompts (redacted). hash: store only a SHA-256 of each prompt.

retention_days.title: Trace retention (days)
retention_days.description: Delete traces and session data older than this.

pii_patterns.title: Extra PII patterns
pii_patterns.description: Regular expressions redacted from traces before they are written, in addition to built-in secret patterns.

trace_location.title: Where traces live
trace_location.description: repo: under <repo>/.harness-evo (needed for the PR check in CI). user: in your own data directory, so nothing is written into the repo.

nudge_ab.title: Join the nudge A/B experiment
nudge_ab.description: Assign each session to nudges on or off by a hash of its id, to measure whether nudging helps.
